title: Server26Extra
description: A pack designed for Server26. Its a vanilla plus pack with creature comfort mods and mods to help your PC use less resources.
body: Mod pack designed for Server26. This pack comes with creature comfort mods and mods that help your pc use less resources. It also comes with extra mods like Ambient sounds for extra biome sounds and the cape mod to let you add capes from the cape mod web site.
